originalTitle: Stefanos Tsitsipas says Nick Kyrgios’s cocaine ban was ‘pretty much expected’
summary: Stefanos Tsitsipas says he is not surprised that Nick Kyrgios was suspended from tennis for taking cocaine
content: Stefanos Tsitsipas says he is not surprised that Nick Kyrgios was suspended from tennis for taking cocaine. “Pretty much expected, to be honest,” Tsitsipas said. “I am surprised it came so late, though.” Kyrgios tested positive for cocaine in June when he was playing at an ATP 250 event in Mallorca. In an Instagram post in August, the Australian said he had “made a huge mistake” and been given a provisional ban from tennis for the offence. He could be suspended for four years, though a lighter punishment is expected. Tsitsipas was asked about Kyrgios on Monday after upsetting the No 10 seed, Arthur Fils, in the first round of the US Open. “I mean, to be entirely honest with you, I knew about this before the announcement. Myself, I knew about it,” Tsitsipas said. “So what can I tell you? I will just tell you the truth. I knew about all of this before any announcement was made, and when I saw it on social media, I was, like, ‘Here we go.’ I kind of expected it, to be honest.” Tsitsipas and Kyrgios played a fiery third-round match at Wimbledon in 2022, when Kyrgios reached his only grand slam final. Tsitsipas blasted a couple of shots directly at Kyrgios, intentionally hit a ball into the crowd, and afterwards called Kyrgios a “bully.” Kyrgios has battled a series of injuries since then and said when he was suspended that he had felt “helpless and alone”. “I’m not going to make excuses, but I do want to give some context about where I’ve been,” wrote in his Instagram post announcing his suspension. “The last couple of years of injuries have taken a huge toll on me, both physically and mentally. My body hasn’t been able to do what my mind expects it to do, and coming to terms with being near the end of my career has been harder than I ever imagined.” Kyrgios’s situation was not a surprise to Tsitsipas. “I knew that those were things that were happening away from the tennis courts. I will tell you that,” he said. “I’m not going to try and cover up someone that I know the truth for. I’ll consider myself a nice person with everyone, but these were behaviors that I personally heard on the tour and heard other people in that same environment saying those sort of things to me.”
chineseTitle: 斯特凡诺斯·西西帕斯表示尼克·克耶高斯的可卡因禁令“几乎在意料之中”
chineseSummary: 斯特凡诺斯·西西帕斯表示，尼克·克耶高斯因服用可卡因而被停赛，他对此并不感到惊讶
chineseContent: 斯特凡诺斯·西西帕斯表示，尼克·克耶高斯因吸食可卡因而被停赛，他对此并不感到惊讶。西西帕斯说：“说实话，这在很大程度上是预料之中的。” “不过，我很惊讶它来得这么晚。”克耶高斯六月份在马略卡岛参加 ATP 250 赛事时检测出可卡因呈阳性。在八月份的一篇 Instagram 帖子中，这位澳大利亚人表示他“犯了一个巨大的错误”，并因此被暂时禁止参加网球比赛。他可能会被禁赛四年，但预计处罚会较轻。西西帕斯在美国公开赛首轮击败十号种子阿瑟·菲尔斯后，周一被问及克耶高斯。 “我的意思是，老实说，我在宣布之前就知道了这一点。我自己也知道这一点，”西西帕斯说。 “那么我能告诉你什么呢？我只会告诉你真相。在任何公告发布之前我就知道这一切，当我在社交媒体上看到它时，我就像是，‘我们开始了’。说实话，我有点期待它。”西西帕斯和克耶高斯在2022年温布尔登网球公开赛第三轮进行了一场激烈的比赛，当时克耶高斯打进了他唯一的大满贯决赛。西西帕斯直接向克耶高斯开了几枪，故意将球击向人群，随后称克耶高斯是“恶霸”。从那时起，克耶高斯一直在与一系列伤病作斗争，他说，当他被停赛时，他感到“无助和孤独”。 “我不会找借口，但我确实想提供一些关于我去过的地方的背景信息，”他在宣布停职的 Instagram 帖子中写道。 “过去几年的伤病对我的身体和精神都造成了巨大的伤害。我的身体无法做到我的想法所期望的，而接受职业生涯即将结束的事实比我想象的要困难。”克耶高斯的情况是
